title: Create: Time Manipulator
description: Create addon for manipulating time and weather
body:
Create: Time Manipulator

> ## ![video demo](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1580665/description_637f1f2b-c425-4e3f-a95f-20449f9aa35d.gif) **A Create addon that lets you control time and weather using rotational force and Sculk-powered machinery.** Harness the eerie pulse of the Deep Dark to skip the night, clear the skies or summon storms — all through a Create-powered machine.
## ✨ Features * Skip to day or night * Set the exact time of day * Change the weather to clear, rain or thunder * Powered by Create rotational force * Uses configurable catalyst items for each operation
## ⚙️ How to Use ![video demo](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1580665/description_d069cdb0-7e42-4ce4-bf28-16bf732386a2.gif) Build the **Time Manipulator** and connect it to a Create rotational power source. Insert the required catalyst item, choose the operation from the GUI and activate the machine. The block will pulse with Sculk energy and bend the world around it. Catalysts, costs and RPM requirements can be adjusted in the config for modpack balancing.
## 🧩 More Create Addons by Us If you enjoy this addon, check out our other Create expansions: * [**💺 Create: Seats Third Person**](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-seats-third-person) — Ride your Create trains, airships and contraptions with a better third-person camera.
Made by **Rampage99TV**
